title.raw: 卷7上 高祖紀上 Volume 7a Annals: Gaozu 1 (Emperor Xiaowen)

sentences.zh: 高祖孝文皇帝，諱宏，顯祖獻文皇帝之長子，母曰李夫人。

translations.literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, bore the taboo name Hong; he was Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen's eldest son; his mother was Lady Li.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, bore the taboo name Hong. He was the eldest son of Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen; his mother was Lady Li.

sentences.zh: 皇興元年八月戊申，生於平城紫宮，神光照於室內，天地氛氳，和氣充塞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Huangxing, on the wushen day, he was born in the Purple Palace at Pingcheng; divine light shone within the chamber, heaven and earth were hazy, and harmonious qi filled all.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Huangxing, on the wushen day, he was born in the Purple Palace at Pingcheng. Divine light shone within the chamber, heaven and earth were hazy, and harmonious qi filled all.

sentences.zh: 帝生而潔白，有異姿，襁褓岐嶷，長而淵裕仁孝，綽然有君人之表。

translations.literal: At birth he was fair and white, with an unusual bearing; even in swaddling clothes he was precocious, and as he grew he was deep, generous, benevolent, and filial, clearly showing the marks of a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: At birth he was fair and white, with an unusual bearing. Even in swaddling clothes he was precocious; as he grew he was deep, generous, benevolent, and filial, clearly showing the marks of a ruler.

sentences.zh: 顯祖尤愛異之。

translations.literal: Xianzu especially loved and prized him.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzu especially loved and prized him.

sentences.zh: 三年夏六月辛未，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer of the third year, on the xinwei day, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer of the third year, on the xinwei day, he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，沃野、統萬二鎮敕勒叛。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the dinghai day, the Tiele of the Wo'ye and Tongwan garrisons rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dinghai day, the Tiele of the Wo'ye and Tongwan garrisons rebelled.

sentences.zh: 詔太尉、隴西王源賀追擊，至枹罕，滅之，斬首三萬餘級；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Grand Commandant Wang Yuanhe of Longxi to pursue and attack; reaching Fuhan, he destroyed them and took more than thirty thousand heads;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Yuanhe, Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi, to pursue and attack. Reaching Fuhan, he destroyed them and took more than thirty thousand heads;

sentences.zh: 徙其遺迸於冀、定、相三州為營戶。

translations.literal: their scattered fugitives were relocated to Ji, Ding, and Xiang provinces as camp households.
translations.idiomatic: their scattered fugitives were relocated to Ji, Ding, and Xiang provinces as camp households.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以征東大將軍、南安王楨為假節、都督涼州及西戎諸軍事、領護西域校尉、儀同三司，鎮涼州。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, General Who Campaigns East, Prince of Nan'an Zhen, was made acting commissioner, Area Commander of Liangzhou and of all western Rong armies, Colonel Protector of the Western Regions, with equipage equal to the Three Directors, and garrisoned Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Zhen, General Who Campaigns East and Prince of Nan'an, was made acting commissioner, area commander of Liangzhou and of all western Rong armies, colonel protector of the Western Regions, with equipage equal to the Three Directors, and garrisoned Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 朔方民曹平原招集不逞，破石樓堡，殺軍將。

translations.literal: The man of Shuofang Cao Pingyuan gathered malcontents, broke Stone Tower Fortress, and killed military officers.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Pingyuan of Shuofang gathered malcontents, broke Stone Tower Fortress, and killed military officers.

sentences.zh: 劉彧將垣崇祖率眾二萬自郁洲寇東兗州，屯于南城固。

translations.literal: Liu Yu's general Yuan Chongzu led twenty thousand men from Yuzhou to raid Dong Yanzhou and encamped at Nanchenggu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chongzu, Liu Yu's general, led twenty thousand men from Yuzhou to raid Dong Yanzhou and encamped at Nanchenggu.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，刺史于洛侯討破之，崇祖還郁洲。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Inspector Yu Luohou defeated them; Chongzu returned to Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Inspector Yu Luohou defeated them, and Chongzu returned to Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 妖賊司馬小君聚眾反於平陵，齊州刺史、武昌王平原討擒之。

translations.literal: The sorcerer-rebel Sima Xiaojun gathered a band and rebelled at Pingling; Inspector of Qi Province, Prince of Wuchang Pingyuan, attacked and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: The sorcerer-rebel Sima Xiaojun gathered a band and rebelled at Pingling; Pingyuan, inspector of Qi province and Prince of Wuchang, attacked and captured him.

sentences.zh: 十有二月乙酉，以駙馬都尉穆亮為趙郡王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou day, Chief Commandant of Attendant Cavalry Mu Liang was made Prince of Zhao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou day, Mu Liang, chief commandant of attendant cavalry, was made Prince of Zhao commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔訪舜後，獲東萊郡民媯苟之，復其家畢世，以彰盛德之不朽。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, an edict sought descendants of Shun; a man of Donglai commandery, Gui Gouzhi, was found; his household was restored for all generations, to manifest the imperishability of supreme virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day an edict sought descendants of Shun. Gui Gouzhi, a man of Donglai commandery, was found, and his household was restored for all generations to manifest the imperishability of supreme virtue.

sentences.zh: 復前濮陽王孔雀本封。

translations.literal: The former Prince of Puyang Kongque's original enfeoffment was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The former Prince of Puyang Kongque's original enfeoffment was restored.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，趙郡王穆亮徙封長樂王。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Prince of Zhao commandery Mu Liang was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Mu Liang, Prince of Zhao commandery, was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙卯，統萬鎮胡民相率北叛。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the yimao day, the Hu people of Tongwan garrison rebelled in succession and fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the yimao day, the Hu people of Tongwan garrison rebelled in succession and fled north.

sentences.zh: 詔寧南將軍、交阯公韓拔等追滅之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South, Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba, and others to pursue and destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Han Ba, General Who Pacifies the South and Duke of Jiaozhi, and others to pursue and destroy them.

sentences.zh: 大陽蠻酋桓誕率戶內屬，拜征南將軍，封襄陽王。

translations.literal: The chief of the Dayang Man, Huan Dan, led his households to submit inward; he was appointed General Who Campaigns South and enfeoffed Prince of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Dan, chief of the Dayang Man, led his households to submit inward; he was appointed General Who Campaigns South and enfeoffed Prince of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 曲赦京師及河西，南至秦涇，西至枹罕，北至涼州諸鎮。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital and west of the Yellow River, south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, and north to the garrisons of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital and west of the Yellow River, south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, and north to the garrisons of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔假員外散騎常侍邢祐使於劉彧。

translations.literal: An edict named Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Xing You envoy to Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Xing You, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，詔曰：「尼父稟達聖之姿，體生知之量，窮理盡性，道光四海。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: an edict said: "Confucius received the bearing of a sage who penetrates all, embodied the measure of innate knowledge, exhausted principle and fulfilled nature, and his Way illumined the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, an edict said, "Confucius received the bearing of a sage who penetrates all, embodied the measure of innate knowledge, exhausted principle and fulfilled nature, and his Way illumined the four seas.

sentences.zh: 頃者淮徐未賓，廟隔非所，致令祠典寢頓，禮章殄滅，遂使女巫妖覡，淫進非禮，殺生鼓舞，倡優媟狎，豈所以尊明神敬聖道者也。

translations.literal: Recently Huai and Xu have not yet submitted, and the temples lie beyond reach; this has caused the sacrificial canon to lapse and ritual statutes to perish, so that sorceresses and shamans advance what is not ritual, kill living creatures for drum-dances, and actors and jesters behave indecently—how can this honor the spirits and revere the sage's Way?
translations.idiomatic: Recently Huai and Xu have not yet submitted, and the temples lie beyond reach; this has caused the sacrificial canon to lapse and ritual statutes to perish, so that sorceresses and shamans advance what is not ritual, kill living creatures for drum-dances, and actors and jesters behave indecently—how can this honor the spirits and revere the sage's Way?

sentences.zh: 自今已後，有祭孔子廟，制用酒脯而已，不聽婦女合雜，以祈非望之福。

translations.literal: From this time forward, when sacrificing at Confucius's temple, use only wine and dried meat; do not allow women to mingle in the rites to pray for undeserved blessings.
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, when sacrificing at Confucius's temple, use only wine and dried meat; do not allow women to mingle in the rites to pray for undeserved blessings.

sentences.zh: 犯者以違制論。

translations.literal: Offenders are to be judged for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Offenders are to be judged for violating regulations.

sentences.zh: 其公家有事，自如常禮。

translations.literal: When the public offices have business, follow the usual rites as before.
translations.idiomatic: When the public offices have business, follow the usual rites as before.

sentences.zh: 犧牲粢盛，務盡豐潔。

translations.literal: Victims and grain offerings must be made fully abundant and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Victims and grain offerings must be made fully abundant and pure.

sentences.zh: 臨事致敬，令肅如也，牧司之官，明糾不法，使禁令必行。

translations.literal: When performing the rites, show reverence so that all is solemn; the pastoral officials are to clearly investigate lawlessness and ensure that prohibitions are enforced.
translations.idiomatic: When performing the rites, show reverence so that all is solemn; the pastoral officials are to clearly investigate lawlessness and ensure that prohibitions are enforced.

sentences.zh: 」蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 太上皇帝次於北郊，詔諸將討之。

translations.literal: The Supreme Emperor halted at the northern suburb and ordered the generals to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Emperor halted at the northern suburb and ordered the generals to attack them.

sentences.zh: 虜遁走。

translations.literal: The barbarians fled and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarians fled and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 其別帥阿大干率千餘落來降。

translations.literal: Their separate commander Agan led more than a thousand encampments to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Their separate commander Agan led more than a thousand encampments to surrender.

sentences.zh: 東部敕勒叛奔蠕蠕，太上皇帝追之，至石磧，不及而還。

translations.literal: The eastern Tiele rebelled and fled to the Rouran; the Supreme Emperor pursued them to Shiji but, unable to overtake them, returned.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern Tiele rebelled and fled to the Rouran; the Supreme Emperor pursued them to Shiji but, unable to overtake them, returned.

sentences.zh: 壬子，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月，太上皇帝至自北討。

translations.literal: Third month: the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以散騎常侍、駙馬都尉萬安國為大司馬、大將軍，封安城王。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, Chief Commandant of Attendant Cavalry Wan Anguo, was made Grand Marshal and Grand General and enfeoffed Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Wan Anguo, palace attendant of scattered cavalry and chief commandant of attendant cavalry, was made grand marshal and grand general and enfeoffed Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 庚午，車駕耕於藉田。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the imperial carriage plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the imperial carriage plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 石城郡獲曹平原，送京師，斬之。

translations.literal: Shicheng commandery captured Cao Pingyuan and sent him to the capital, where he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng commandery captured Cao Pingyuan and sent him to the capital, where he was executed.

sentences.zh: 連川敕勒謀叛，徙配青、徐、齊、兗四州為營戶。

translations.literal: The Tiele of Lianchuan plotted rebellion; they were relocated and assigned to Qing, Xu, Qi, and Yan provinces as camp households.
translations.idiomatic: The Tiele of Lianchuan plotted rebellion; they were relocated and assigned to Qing, Xu, Qi, and Yan provinces as camp households.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，詔工商雜伎，盡聽赴農。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengzi: an edict that artisans, merchants, and miscellaneous performers were all permitted to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, an edict permitted artisans, merchants, and miscellaneous performers to return to farming.

sentences.zh: 諸州郡課民益種菜果。

translations.literal: All provinces and commanderies were charged to urge the people to plant more vegetables and fruit.
translations.idiomatic: All provinces and commanderies were charged to urge the people to plant more vegetables and fruit.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，劉彧遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔沙門不得去寺，浮遊民間，行者仰以公文。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, an edict that monks were not to leave their monasteries and wander among the people; travelers must carry official documents.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day an edict forbade monks to leave their monasteries and wander among the people; travelers had to carry official documents.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉彧死，子昱僭立。

translations.literal: That month Liu Yu died; his son the younger Liu Yu usurped the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Yu died; his son the younger Liu Yu usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，詔軍警給璽印、傳符，次給馬印。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: an edict that military alerts were to be supplied with seals and tallies first, and horse brands second.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingsi day, an edict ordered that military alerts be supplied with seals and tallies first and horse brands second.

sentences.zh: [1]六月，安州民遇水雹，丐租賑恤。

translations.literal: [1] Sixth month: the people of An province suffered hail; they begged remission of rent and relief.
translations.idiomatic: [1] In the sixth month the people of An province suffered hail; they begged remission of rent and relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「頃者州郡選貢，多不以實，碩人所以窮處幽仄，鄙夫所以超分妄進，豈所謂旌賢樹德者也。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, an edict said: "Recently when provinces and commanderies selected tribute candidates, many were not according to fact; thus worthy men are stranded in remote corners while base men overstep and advance rashly—is this what is called honoring the worthy and planting virtue?
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict said, "Recently when provinces and commanderies selected tribute candidates, many were not according to fact; thus worthy men are stranded in remote corners while base men overstep and advance rashly—is this what is called honoring the worthy and planting virtue?

sentences.zh: 今年貢舉，尤為猥濫。

translations.literal: This year's selections were especially coarse and excessive.
translations.idiomatic: This year's selections were especially coarse and excessive.

sentences.zh: 自今所遣，皆門盡州郡之高，才極鄉閭之選。

translations.literal: From this time forward, all who are sent must be the highest of their gate in the province and commandery, and the utmost choice of village and hamlet."
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, all who are sent must be the highest of their gate in the province and commandery, and the utmost choice of village and hamlet."

sentences.zh: 」閏月壬子，蠕蠕寇敦煌，鎮將尉多侯擊走之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renzi: the Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Wei Duohou drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the renzi day, the Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Wei Duohou drove them off.

sentences.zh: 又寇晉昌，守將薛奴擊走之。

translations.literal: They also raided Jinchang; the defending commander Xue Nu drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: They also raided Jinchang; the defending commander Xue Nu drove them off.

sentences.zh: 戊午，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the court traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the court traveled to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，光州民孫晏等聚黨千餘人叛，通劉昱，刺史叔孫璝討平之。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: Sun Yan of Guang province and others gathered a band of more than a thousand and rebelled, communicating with the younger Liu Yu; Inspector Shusun Gui suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Sun Yan of Guang province and others gathered a band of more than a thousand and rebelled, communicating with the younger Liu Yu; Inspector Shusun Gui suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔州郡縣各遣二人才堪專對者，赴九月講武，當親問風俗。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, an edict that each province, commandery, and county was to send two men of talent fit for specialized replies, to attend the ninth-month martial review, when the ruler would personally question them on local customs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict ordered each province, commandery, and county to send two men of talent fit for specialized replies to attend the ninth-month martial review, when the ruler would personally question them on local customs.

sentences.zh: [2]八月丙辰，百濟國遣使奉表請師伐高麗。

translations.literal: [2] Eighth month, day bingchen: the state of Baekje sent envoys with a memorial requesting troops to attack Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: [2] In the eighth month, on the bingchen day, the state of Baekje sent envoys with a memorial requesting troops to attack Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，地豆于、庫莫奚國遣使朝貢，昌亭國遣使獻蜀馬。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the states of Didouyu and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute; the state of Changting sent envoys presenting Shu horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the states of Didouyu and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute; the state of Changting sent envoys presenting Shu horses.

sentences.zh: 河西費也頭反，薄骨律鎮將擊走之。

translations.literal: The Feiye Tou of Hexi rebelled; the Bogu'lu garrison commander drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The Feiye Tou of Hexi rebelled; the Bogu'lu garrison commander drove them off.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，統萬鎮將、河間王閭虎皮坐貪殘賜死。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, the Tongwan garrison commander, Prince of Hejian Yan Hupi, was sentenced to death for greed and cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Yan Hupi, Tongwan garrison commander and Prince of Hejian, was sentenced to death for greed and cruelty.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔以州鎮十一水，丐民田租，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, an edict remitted field rent where eleven provinces and garrisons had suffered flood, and ordered granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict remitted field rent where eleven provinces and garrisons had suffered flood, and ordered granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 又詔流迸之民，皆令還本，違者配徙邊鎮。

translations.literal: Another edict that all fugitive and scattered people were to return to their origins; violators were to be assigned to frontier garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered all fugitive and scattered people to return to their origins; violators were to be assigned to frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，蠕蠕犯塞，及於五原。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: the Rouran raided the frontier as far as Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Rouran raided the frontier as far as Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，太上皇帝親討之，將度漠襲擊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the Supreme Emperor personally campaigned against them, intending to cross the desert and strike.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Supreme Emperor personally campaigned against them, intending to cross the desert and strike.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕聞軍至，大懼，北走數千里。

translations.literal: When the Rouran heard the army had come, they were greatly afraid and fled north several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: When the Rouran heard the army had come, they were greatly afraid and fled north several thousand li.

sentences.zh: 以窮寇遠遁，不可追，乃止。

translations.literal: Because the exhausted foe had fled far, they could not be pursued, and the campaign halted.
translations.idiomatic: Because the exhausted foe had fled far, they could not be pursued, and the campaign halted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封皇叔略為廣川王。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the Emperor's uncle Lue was enfeoffed Prince of Guangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the emperor's uncle Lue was enfeoffed Prince of Guangchuan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，分遣使者巡省風俗，問民疾苦。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, envoys were dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs and inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day envoys were dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs and inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 帝每月一朝崇光宮。

translations.literal: Each month the Emperor paid court at Chongguang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Each month the emperor paid court at Chongguang Palace.

sentences.zh: 十有二月庚戌，詔曰：「書云：『三載一考，三考黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: an edict said: "The Documents say: 'Every three years conduct a review; after three reviews promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, an edict said, "The Documents say: 'Every three years conduct a review; after three reviews promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.'

sentences.zh: 』頃者已來，官以勞升，未久而代，牧守無恤民之心，競為聚斂，送故迎新，相屬於路，非所以固民志，隆治道也。

translations.literal: Recently officials have been promoted for mere toil and replaced before long; governors and magistrates have no mind to comfort the people but compete in amassing wealth, seeing off the old and welcoming the new in endless succession on the roads—this is not how to fix the people's will and exalt the way of rule.
translations.idiomatic: Recently officials have been promoted for mere toil and replaced before long; governors and magistrates have no mind to comfort the people but compete in amassing wealth, seeing off the old and welcoming the new in endless succession on the roads—this is not how to fix the people's will and exalt the way of rule.

sentences.zh: 自今牧守溫仁清儉、克己奉公者，可久於其任。

translations.literal: From this time forward, governors and magistrates who are warm, benevolent, pure, and frugal and who restrain themselves and serve the public may hold office for long.
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, governors and magistrates who are warm, benevolent, pure, and frugal and who restrain themselves and serve the public may hold office for long.

sentences.zh: 歲積有成，遷位一級。

translations.literal: When year after year they accumulate achievement, advance them one rank.
translations.idiomatic: When year after year they accumulate achievement, advance them one rank.

sentences.zh: 其有貪殘非道、侵削黎庶者，雖在官甫爾，必加黜罰。

translations.literal: Those who are greedy, cruel, and contrary to the Way and who encroach on the common people, though they have just taken office, must be demoted and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who are greedy, cruel, and contrary to the Way and who encroach on the common people, though they have just taken office, must be demoted and punished.

sentences.zh: 著之於令，永為彝準。

translations.literal: Inscribe this in the statutes as an eternal standard."
translations.idiomatic: Inscribe this in the statutes as an eternal standard."

sentences.zh: 」詔以代郡事同豐沛，代民先配邊戍者皆免之。

translations.literal: An edict that because Dai commandery was comparable to Feng and Pei, all Dai people previously assigned to frontier garrison duty were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict held that because Dai commandery was comparable to Feng and Pei, all Dai people previously assigned to frontier garrison duty were exempted.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚辰，詔員外散騎常侍崔演使於劉昱。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day gengchen: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Cui Yan was envoy to the younger Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the gengchen day, an edict named Cui Yan, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to the younger Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，改崇光宮為寧光宮。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Chongguang Palace was renamed Ningguang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Chongguang Palace was renamed Ningguang Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊戌。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day.

sentences.zh: 太上皇帝還至雲中。

translations.literal: The Supreme Emperor returned to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Emperor returned to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 是月，相州執送妖人榮永安於京師，斬之。

translations.literal: That month, Xiang province seized and sent the sorcerer Rong Yong'an to the capital, where he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiang province seized and sent the sorcerer Rong Yong'an to the capital, where he was executed.

sentences.zh: 詔赦其支黨。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned his associates.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned his associates.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，高麗、契丹國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: Goryeo and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wushen day, Goryeo and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔牧守令長，勤率百姓，無令失時。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, an edict that governors, magistrates, and chiefs were diligently to lead the people and not let them miss the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day an edict charged governors, magistrates, and chiefs diligently to lead the people and not let them miss the seasons.

sentences.zh: 同部之內，貧富相通。

translations.literal: Within the same district, rich and poor were to aid one another.
translations.idiomatic: Within the same district, rich and poor were to aid one another.

sentences.zh: 家有兼牛，通借無者，若不從詔，一門之內終身不仕。

translations.literal: Households with an extra ox were to lend to those without; if they did not obey the edict, no one in the gate might hold office for life.
translations.idiomatic: Households with an extra ox were to lend to those without; if they did not obey the edict, no one in the gate might hold office for life.

sentences.zh: 守宰不督察，免所居官。

translations.literal: Magistrates who did not supervise were removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates who did not supervise were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太上皇帝至自北討，飲至策勳，告於宗廟。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign, held a drinking ceremony and recorded merit, and reported to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the Supreme Emperor returned from the northern campaign, held a drinking ceremony and recorded merit, and reported to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 死王事者復其家。

translations.literal: Those who died in royal service had their households restored.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died in royal service had their households restored.

sentences.zh: 詔畿內民從役死事者，郡縣為迎喪，給以葬費。

translations.literal: An edict that within the capital districts, people who died on corvée service, the commanderies and counties were to receive the coffin and supply burial expenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that within the capital districts, when people died on corvée service, the commanderies and counties were to receive the coffin and supply burial expenses.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔縣令能靜一縣劫盜者，兼治二縣，即食其祿；

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, an edict that a county chief who could pacify banditry in one county might concurrently administer two counties and receive both salaries;
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day an edict held that a county chief who could pacify banditry in one county might concurrently administer two counties and receive both salaries;

sentences.zh: 能靜二縣者，兼治三縣，三年遷為郡守。

translations.literal: one who could pacify two counties might administer three, and after three years be transferred to commandery governor.
translations.idiomatic: one who could pacify two counties might administer three, and after three years be transferred to commandery governor.

sentences.zh: 二千石能靜二郡，上至三郡，亦如之，三年遷為刺史。

translations.literal: A two-thousand-dan official who could pacify two commanderies might rise to three, likewise; after three years he was transferred to inspector.
translations.idiomatic: A two-thousand-dan official who could pacify two commanderies might rise to three, likewise; after three years he was transferred to inspector.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，詔諸倉囤穀麥充積者，出賜貧民。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: an edict that wherever granaries were fully stocked with grain and wheat, the surplus was to be given out to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered that wherever granaries were fully stocked with grain and wheat, the surplus was to be given out to the poor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，詔假司空、上黨王長孫觀等討吐谷渾拾寅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: an edict that Acting Minister of Works, Prince of Shangdang Changsun Guan, and others were to campaign against Tuyuhun Sheyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wushen day, an edict ordered Changsun Guan, acting minister of works and Prince of Shangdang, and others to campaign against Tuyuhun Sheyin.

sentences.zh: 壬子，契丹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the Khitan state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the Khitan state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔以孔子二十八世孫魯郡孔乘為崇聖大夫，給十戶以供洒掃。

translations.literal: An edict that Kong Sheng of Lu commandery, twenty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, was made Grand Master of Veneration of the Sage and given ten households for libation and sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Kong Sheng of Lu commandery, twenty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, Grand Master of Veneration of the Sage and gave him ten households for libation and sweeping.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，詔曰：「往年縣召民秀二人，問以守宰治狀，善惡具聞，將加賞罰。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: an edict said: "In past years the counties summoned two worthy youths from among the people and questioned them on the governors' and magistrates' conduct; good and evil were all heard, with rewards and punishments to follow.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiazi day, an edict said, "In past years the counties summoned two worthy youths from among the people and questioned them on the governors' and magistrates' conduct; good and evil were all heard, with rewards and punishments to follow.

sentences.zh: 而賞者未幾，罪者眾多。

translations.literal: Yet those rewarded were few while those punished were many.
translations.idiomatic: Yet those rewarded were few while those punished were many.

sentences.zh: 肆法傷生，情所未忍。

translations.literal: Wantonly applying the law harms life—this Our heart cannot bear.
translations.idiomatic: Wantonly applying the law harms life—this our heart cannot bear.

sentences.zh: 今特垂寬恕之恩，申以解網之惠。

translations.literal: Now We specially extend the grace of broad pardon and declare the benefit of loosening the net.
translations.idiomatic: Now we specially extend the grace of broad pardon and declare the benefit of loosening the net.

sentences.zh: 諸為民所列者，特原其罪，盡可貸之。」

translations.literal: All who were denounced by the people are specially pardoned of their crimes and may all be ransomed."
translations.idiomatic: All who were denounced by the people are specially pardoned of their crimes and may all be ransomed."

sentences.zh: 秋七月，詔河南六州之民，戶收絹一匹，綿一斤，租三十石。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: an edict that the people of the six Henan provinces were to pay one bolt of silk and one jin of cotton per household, and thirty shi of rent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn an edict ordered the people of the six Henan provinces to pay one bolt of silk and one jin of cotton per household, and thirty shi of rent.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the court traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day the court traveled to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕寇敦煌，鎮將樂洛生擊破之。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Yue Luosheng defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Yue Luosheng defeated them.

sentences.zh: 事具蠕蠕傳。

translations.literal: The matter is given in full in the Rouran treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The matter is given in full in the Rouran treatise.

sentences.zh: 劉昱遣將寇緣淮諸鎮，徐州刺史、淮陽公尉元擊走之。

translations.literal: the younger Liu Yu sent generals to raid the garrisons along the Huai; Wei Yuan, inspector of Xuzhou and Duke of Huaiyang, drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The younger Liu Yu sent generals to raid the garrisons along the Huai; Wei Yuan, inspector of Xuzhou and Duke of Huaiyang, drove them off.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，高麗、庫莫奚國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: Goryeo and the state of Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou day, Goryeo and the state of Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝從太上皇帝幸河西。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, the Emperor followed the Supreme Emperor to the west of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the emperor followed the Supreme Emperor to the west of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 拾寅謝罪請降，許之。

translations.literal: Sheyin apologized and begged to surrender; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Sheyin apologized and begged to surrender; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，車駕並還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: the imperial carriages all returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinsi day, the imperial carriages all returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，[3]劉昱遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, [3] the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day [3] the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔曰：「自今京師及天下之囚，罪未分判，在獄致死無近親者，公給衣衾棺櫝葬埋之，不得曝露。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, an edict said: "From this time forward, for all prisoners in the capital and throughout the realm whose crimes are not yet judged, if they die in prison without close kin, the state is to supply shroud, coffin, and burial and must not leave them exposed."
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict said, "From this time forward, for all prisoners in the capital and throughout the realm whose crimes are not yet judged, if they die in prison without close kin, the state is to supply shroud, coffin, and burial and must not leave them exposed."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，詔遣使者十人循行州郡，檢括戶口。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, an edict dispatched ten envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and check household registers.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict dispatched ten envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and check household registers.

sentences.zh: 其有仍隱不出者，州、郡、縣、戶主並論如律。

translations.literal: Those who still concealed themselves and did not appear—the province, commandery, county, and household head were all judged according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Those who still concealed themselves and did not appear—the province, commandery, county, and household head were all judged according to law.

sentences.zh: 庫莫奚國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，太上皇帝親將南討。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: the Supreme Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Supreme Emperor personally led a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 詔州郡之民，十丁取一以充行，戶收租五十石，以備軍糧。

translations.literal: An edict that of the people in provinces and commanderies one man in ten was taken for service, and fifty shi of rent per household was collected to provision the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that of the people in provinces and commanderies one man in ten was taken for service, and fifty shi of rent per household was collected to provision the army.

sentences.zh: 悉萬斤國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 武都王反，攻仇池。

translations.literal: The Prince of Wudu rebelled and attacked Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Wudu rebelled and attacked Chouchi.

sentences.zh: [4]詔長孫觀仍回師討之。

translations.literal: [4] An edict that Changsun Guan was to turn his army back and campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: [4] An edict ordered Changsun Guan to turn his army back and campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 十有一月戊寅，詔以河南七州牧守多不奉法，致新邦之民莫能上達，遣使者觀風察獄，黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: an edict that because the governors and magistrates of the seven Henan provinces mostly did not observe the law, the people of the new territories could not reach the throne, envoys were sent to observe the winds and examine prisons, and promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuyin day, an edict held that because the governors and magistrates of the seven Henan provinces mostly did not observe the law and the people of the new territories could not reach the throne, envoys were sent to observe the winds and examine prisons and promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.

sentences.zh: 其有鰥寡孤獨貧不自存者，復其雜徭，年八十已上，一子不從役；

translations.literal: Those who were widowed, orphaned, solitary, or destitute and could not support themselves had miscellaneous corvées remitted; those eighty and above had one son exempt from service;
translations.idiomatic: Those who were widowed, orphaned, solitary, or destitute and could not support themselves had miscellaneous corvées remitted; those eighty and above had one son exempt from service;

sentences.zh: 力田孝悌，才器有益於時，信義著於鄉閭者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: those diligent in farming, filial and fraternal, whose talent and ability benefited the age, and whose faith and righteousness were renowned in village and hamlet were all to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: those diligent in farming, filial and fraternal, whose talent and ability benefited the age, and whose faith and righteousness were renowned in village and hamlet were all to be reported by name.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太上皇帝南巡，至於懷州。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, the Supreme Emperor toured south as far as Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the Supreme Emperor toured south as far as Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 所過問民疾苦，賜高年、孝悌力田布帛。

translations.literal: Where he passed he inquired into the people's hardships and bestowed cloth and silk on the aged, the filial, the fraternal, and the diligent in farming.
translations.idiomatic: Where he passed he inquired into the people's hardships and bestowed cloth and silk on the aged, the filial, the fraternal, and the diligent in farming.

sentences.zh: 十有二月庚戌，詔關外苑囿聽民樵採。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: an edict that the parks beyond the passes permitted the people to gather firewood.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, an edict permitted the people to gather firewood in the parks beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蠕蠕犯邊，柔玄鎮二部敕勒叛應之。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the Rouran raided the frontier; the two divisions of Tiele at Rouxuan garrison rebelled in response.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the Rouran raided the frontier; the two divisions of Tiele at Rouxuan garrison rebelled in response.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，沙門慧隱謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, the monk Huiyin plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the monk Huiyin plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，州鎮十一水旱，丐民田租，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: That year eleven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; field rent was begged and granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year eleven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; field rent was begged and granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 相州民餓死者二千八百四十五人。

translations.literal: In Xiang province two thousand eight hundred forty-five people died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiang province two thousand eight hundred forty-five people died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾部內羌民鍾豈渴干等二千三百戶內附。

translations.literal: Within Tuyuhun, more than two thousand three hundred Qiang households under Zhong Kai'gan submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Within Tuyuhun, more than two thousand three hundred Qiang households under Zhong Kai'gan submitted inward.

sentences.zh: 是年，妖人劉舉自稱天子，齊州刺史、武昌王平原捕斬之。

translations.literal: That year the sorcerer Liu Ju styled himself Son of Heaven; Pingyuan, inspector of Qi province and Prince of Wuchang, captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: That year the sorcerer Liu Ju styled himself Son of Heaven; Pingyuan, inspector of Qi province and Prince of Wuchang, captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁丑，侍中、太尉、隴西王源賀以病辭位。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day dingchou: Attendant-in-Ordinary, Grand Commandant, Prince of Longxi Wang Yuanhe resigned office on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the dingchou day, Wang Yuanhe, attendant-in-ordinary, grand commandant, and Prince of Longxi, resigned office on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，粟特國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day the state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，太上皇帝至自南巡。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: the Supreme Emperor returned from the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiachen day, the Supreme Emperor returned from the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吐谷渾拾寅遣子費斗斤入侍，并獻方物。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Tuyuhun Sheyin sent his son Feidoujin to attend court and also presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Tuyuhun Sheyin sent his son Feidoujin to attend court and also presented local products.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁斷寒食。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the Cold Food Festival was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the Cold Food Festival was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，詔員外散騎常侍許赤虎使於劉昱。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Xu Chihu was envoy to the younger Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dinghai day, an edict named Xu Chihu, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to the younger Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 高麗、吐谷渾、曹利諸國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Cao Li, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Cao Li, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day jiaxu: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the jiaxu day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，詔曰：「朕應歷數開一之期，屬千載光熙之運，雖仰嚴誨，猶懼德化不寬，至有門房之誅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: an edict said: "We have received the opening of the one era in the sequence of fate and belong to the fortune of a thousand years of glorious peace; though We revere stern instruction, We still fear virtue and transformation are not broad enough, even to the punishment of entire clans.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yimao day, an edict said, "We have received the opening of the one era in the sequence of fate and belong to the fortune of a thousand years of glorious peace; though we revere stern instruction, we still fear virtue and transformation are not broad enough, even to the punishment of entire clans.

sentences.zh: 然下民兇戾，不顧親戚，一人為惡，殃及合門。

translations.literal: Yet the lower people are fierce and cruel and heed not kin; when one man does evil, calamity reaches the whole gate.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the lower people are fierce and cruel and heed not kin; when one man does evil, calamity reaches the whole gate.

sentences.zh: 朕為民父母，深所愍悼。

translations.literal: We, as father and mother to the people, deeply mourn this.
translations.idiomatic: We, as father and mother to the people, deeply mourn this.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，非謀反、大逆、干紀、外奔，罪止其身而已。

translations.literal: From this time forward, except for treason, great rebellion, violation of the statutes, and flight abroad, guilt stops with the person alone.
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, except for treason, great rebellion, violation of the statutes, and flight abroad, guilt stops with the person alone.

sentences.zh: 今德被殊方，文軌將一，宥刑寬禁，不亦善乎？

translations.literal: Now virtue spreads to distant regions and written culture is about to be one; to pardon punishments and broaden prohibitions—is this not good?"

translations.idiomatic: Corvée should be simplified, encouragement put first, water and land be surveyed, and full use be made of the land's advantage, so that farmers spread outward and mulberry women labor within.

sentences.zh: 若輕有徵發，致奪民時，以侵擅論。

translations.literal: If corvée is lightly issued and the people's seasons are seized, judge it as encroachment and usurpation.
translations.idiomatic: If corvée is lightly issued and the people's seasons are seized, judge it as encroachment and usurpation.

translations.idiomatic: People who do not follow the chief's teaching and are idle in farming and sericulture are to be punished.

translations.literal: The Taihe and Anchang halls were begun.
translations.idiomatic: The Taihe and Anchang halls were begun.

sentences.zh: 己酉，秦州略陽民王元壽聚眾五千餘家，自號為衝天王。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Wang Yuanshou of Lueyang in Qinzhou gathered more than five thousand households and styled himself Chongtian King.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Wang Yuanshou of Lueyang in Qinzhou gathered more than five thousand households and styled himself Chongtian King.

sentences.zh: 雲中飢，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Yunzhong suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yunzhong suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，漢川民泉會、譚酉等相率內屬，處之并州。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: the people of Hanchuan, Quan Hui, Tan You, and others led one another inward and were settled in Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingyin day, the people of Hanchuan, Quan Hui, Tan You, and others led one another inward and were settled in Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秦益二州刺史、武都公尉洛侯討破元壽，獲其妻子，送京師。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Wei Luohou, inspector of Qin and Yi provinces and Duke of Wudu, defeated Yuanshou, captured his wife and children, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Wei Luohou, inspector of Qin and Yi provinces and Duke of Wudu, defeated Yuanshou, captured his wife and children, and sent them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸未，高麗、契丹、庫莫奚國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Goryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Goryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，徵征西大將軍、雍州刺史、東陽王丕為司徒。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: General Who Campaigns West, Inspector of Yong Province, Prince of Dongyang Pi, was summoned and made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengzi day, Pi, general who campaigns west, inspector of Yong province, and Prince of Dongyang, was summoned and made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔曰：「朕政治多闕，災眚屢興。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict said: "Our rule has many gaps and calamities have repeatedly arisen.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict said, "Our rule has many gaps and calamities have repeatedly arisen.

sentences.zh: 去年牛疫，死傷太半，耕墾之利，當有虧損。

translations.literal: Last year cattle pestilence killed more than half; the profit of plowing must have suffered loss.
translations.idiomatic: Last year cattle pestilence killed more than half; the profit of plowing must have suffered loss.

sentences.zh: 今東作既興，人湏肄業。

translations.literal: Now eastern work has begun and the people must practice their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Now eastern work has begun and the people must practice their occupations.

sentences.zh: 其敕在所督課田農，有牛者加勤於常歲，無牛者倍庸於餘年。

translations.literal: Charge the local supervisors to urge farming: those with cattle must labor more diligently than in ordinary years; those without cattle must pay double hired labor beyond other years.
translations.idiomatic: Charge the local supervisors to urge farming: those with cattle must labor more diligently than in ordinary years; those without cattle must pay double hired labor beyond other years.

sentences.zh: 一夫制治田四十畝，中男二十畝。

translations.literal: One adult man is to cultivate forty mu; a secondary adult twenty mu.
translations.idiomatic: One adult man is to cultivate forty mu; a secondary adult twenty mu.

sentences.zh: 無令人有餘力，地有遺利。

translations.literal: Do not let people have surplus strength while land has neglected profit."
translations.idiomatic: Do not let people have surplus strength while land has neglected profit."

translations.idiomatic: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the court visited Mount Baideng.

translations.idiomatic: An edict restored the former Prince of Dongjun Lu Dingguo's office and rank.

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiyou: the imperial carriage prayed for rain at Mount Wuzhou; soon timely rain fell abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, the imperial carriage prayed for rain at Mount Wuzhou; soon timely rain fell abundantly.

translations.literal: The Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day renchen: Attendant-in-Ordinary, General with Staff and Equipage Equal to the Three Directors, Inspector of Qing Province, Prince of Jingzhao Zitui, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renchen day, Zitui, attendant-in-ordinary, general with staff and equipage equal to the Three Directors, inspector of Qing province, and Prince of Jingzhao, died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定三等死刑。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, three grades of capital punishment were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day three grades of capital punishment were fixed.

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, the Taihe and Anchang halls were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the Taihe and Anchang halls were completed.

translations.idiomatic: The Zhuming and Sixian gates were begun.

translations.idiomatic: That month the younger Liu Yu died; his younger brother Liu Zhun usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renzi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict said, "Artisans, merchants, and menials each have their station, yet the offices have been lax and some have stained the pure current.

sentences.zh: 自今戶內有工役者，推上本部丞，[6]已下準次而授。

translations.literal: From this time, within the household those with corvée labor are to be referred up to their department chief, [6] and below appointment follows rank in order.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, within the household those with corvée labor are to be referred up to their department chief, [6] and below appointment follows rank in order.

translations.literal: Those who rely on founding merit and settled the state by toil are not subject to this regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Those who rely on founding merit and settled the state by toil are not subject to this regulation."

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiwei: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiwei day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔羣臣定律令於太華殿。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, an edict that the assembled ministers fix laws and ordinances in the Taihua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day an edict ordered the assembled ministers to fix laws and ordinances in the Taihua Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，起永樂遊觀殿於北苑，穿神淵池。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, the Yongle touring-view hall was begun in the northern park, and the Divine Abyss pool was dug.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day the Yongle touring-view hall was begun in the northern park, and the Divine Abyss pool was dug.

sentences.zh: 車多羅、西天竺、舍衞、疊伏羅諸國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The states of Chaduo, western Tianzhu, Shewei, and Diefuluo each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Chaduo, western Tianzhu, Shewei, and Diefuluo each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiyou: the capital's elderly seventy and above were feasted in the Taihua Hall and given clothing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the guiyou day, the capital's elderly seventy and above were feasted in the Taihua Hall and given clothing.

translations.literal: That month, Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 又詔七十已上一子不從役。

translations.literal: Another edict that those seventy and above had one son exempt from service.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict held that those seventy and above had one son exempt from service.

sentences.zh: 龜茲國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: The state of Kucha sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Kucha sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 劉準葭蘆戍主楊文度遣弟鼠襲陷仇池。

translations.literal: Yang Wendu, garrison commander of Jialu in Liu Zhun's realm, sent his younger brother Shu to raid and seize Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wendu, garrison commander of Jialu in Liu Zhun's realm, sent his younger brother Shu to raid and seize Chouchi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，誅徐州刺史李訢。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Li Xin, inspector of Xuzhou, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Li Xin, inspector of Xuzhou, was executed.

sentences.zh: 庫莫奚、契丹國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiwei: an edict that General Who Campaigns West, Duke of Guangchuan Pi Huanxi; General Who Pacifies the West Liang Chounu; General Who Pacifies the West Yang Lingzhen, and others, led forty thousand troops to campaign against Yang Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiwei day, an edict ordered Pi Huanxi, general who campaigns west and Duke of Guangchuan; Liang Chounu, general who pacifies the west; Yang Lingzhen, general who pacifies the west; and others to lead forty thousand troops to campaign against Yang Shu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，吐谷渾國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，懷州民伊祁苟初自稱堯後應王，聚眾於重山。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Yi Qigou of Huai province styled himself descendant of Yao and King Who Responds, gathering a multitude at Chong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Yi Qigou of Huai province styled himself descendant of Yao and King Who Responds, gathering a multitude at Chong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 洛州刺史馮熙討滅之。

translations.literal: Feng Xi, inspector of Luozhou, attacked and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xi, inspector of Luozhou, attacked and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 閏月，懽喜等軍到建安，楊鼠棄城南走。

translations.literal: Intercalary month: Huanxi and the other armies reached Jian'an; Yang Shu abandoned the city and fled south.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Huanxi and the other armies reached Jian'an; Yang Shu abandoned the city and fled south.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，粟提婆國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the state of Sutipo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the state of Sutipo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔員外散騎常侍李長仁使於劉準。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Li Changren was envoy to Liu Zhun.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day an edict named Li Changren, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Liu Zhun.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬寅，懽喜攻陷葭蘆，斬文度，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: Huanxi captured Jialu, beheaded Wendu, and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin day, Huanxi captured Jialu, beheaded Wendu, and sent his head to the capital.

translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the states of Yuan Kuo and Tuyuhun each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔以州郡八水旱蝗，民飢，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, an edict that in eight provinces and commanderies that suffered flood, drought, and locusts and where the people were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict ordered granaries opened for relief in eight provinces and commanderies that suffered flood, drought, and locusts and where the people were hungry.

sentences.zh: 以安定王休為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Prince of Anding Xiu was made with equipage equal to the Three Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu, Prince of Anding, was granted equipage equal to the Three Directors.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，封昌黎王馮熙第二子始興為北平王。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day dingsi: Shixing, second son of Prince of Changli Feng Xi, was enfeoffed Prince of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the dingsi day, Shixing, second son of Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was enfeoffed Prince of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊午，吐谷渾遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，行幸代之湯泉。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: the court traveled to the hot springs of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dinghai day, the court traveled to the hot springs of Dai.

sentences.zh: 所過問民疾苦，以宮人賜貧民無妻者。

translations.literal: Where it passed it inquired into the people's hardships and gave palace women to poor men without wives.
translations.idiomatic: Where it passed it inquired into the people's hardships and gave palace women to poor men without wives.

translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: Liang Miji, Duke of Henan, was made Prince of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingzi day, Liang Miji, Duke of Henan, was made Prince of Dangchang.

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: the court visited Mount Guo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiashen day, the court visited Mount Guo.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the court returned to the palace.

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 京師旱。

translations.literal: The capital suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: [7]甲辰，祈天災於北苑，親自禮焉。

translations.literal: [7] On the jiachen day, prayed against heavenly calamity in the northern park and personally performed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: [7] On the jiachen day the emperor prayed against heavenly calamity in the northern park and personally performed the rites.

sentences.zh: 減膳，避正殿。

translations.literal: Food was reduced and the main hall avoided.
translations.idiomatic: Food was reduced and the main hall avoided.

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, timely rain fell abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day timely rain fell abundantly.

translations.literal: A partial amnesty in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

translations.literal: Fifth month, an edict said: "When betrothal gifts exceed ritual, marriage and taking wives suffer the harm of missing the season;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an edict said, "When betrothal gifts exceed ritual, marriage and taking wives suffer the harm of missing the season;

sentences.zh: 厚葬送終，則生者有糜費之苦。

translations.literal: when burial and seeing off the dead are lavish, the living suffer the pain of wasted expense.
translations.idiomatic: when burial and seeing off the dead are lavish, the living suffer the pain of wasted expense.

sentences.zh: 聖王知其如此，故申之以禮數，約之以法禁。

translations.literal: The sage kings knew this and therefore extended them with ritual numbers and bound them with legal prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: The sage kings knew this and therefore extended them with ritual numbers and bound them with legal prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 迺者，民漸奢尚，婚葬越軌，致貧富相高，貴賤無別。

translations.literal: Lately the people have gradually turned to luxury; marriage and burial overstep the track, making rich and poor vie in height and noble and base without distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the people have gradually turned to luxury; marriage and burial overstep the track, making rich and poor vie in height and noble and base without distinction.

translations.idiomatic: Moreover imperial clans, noble kin, and scholar-official households, heedless of clan, marry down to unworthy classes.

translations.idiomatic: [8] The former emperor personally issued a bright edict establishing prohibitions by statute, yet the people clung to custom and still did not reform.

translations.idiomatic: We now reverence the old canon and reverently follow the former system, inscribing it in laws and ordinances as an eternal standard.
