sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔罷諸州禽獸之貢。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, an edict abolished tribute of birds and beasts from all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day an edict abolished tribute of birds and beasts from all provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，勿吉國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the state of Mohe sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the state of Mohe sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen: a partial amnesty in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingchen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 龜茲國遣使獻大馬、名駝、珍寶甚眾。

translations.literal: The state of Kucha sent envoys presenting great horses, famous camels, and many treasures.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Kucha sent envoys presenting great horses, famous camels, and many treasures.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，詔員外散騎常侍鄭羲使於劉準。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day renchen: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Zheng Xi was envoy to Liu Zhun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renchen day, an edict named Zheng Xi, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Liu Zhun.

sentences.zh: 十有一月庚戌，詔曰：「懸爵於朝，而有功者必縻其賞；

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: an edict said: "When ranks are suspended at court, those with merit must be bound to reward;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengxu day, an edict said, "When ranks are suspended at court, those with merit must be bound to reward;

sentences.zh: 懸刑於市，而有罪者必罹其辜。

translations.literal: when punishments are suspended in the market, those with guilt must suffer their penalty.
translations.idiomatic: when punishments are suspended in the market, those with guilt must suffer their penalty.

sentences.zh: 斯乃古今之成典，治道之實要。

translations.literal: This is the settled canon of ancient and modern times and the solid essentials of the way of rule.
translations.idiomatic: This is the settled canon of ancient and modern times and the solid essentials of the way of rule.

sentences.zh: 諸州刺史，牧民之官，自頃以來，遂各怠慢，縱姦納賂，背公緣私，致令賊盜並興，侵劫茲甚，姦宄之聲屢聞朕聽。

translations.literal: The provincial inspectors are officials who pasture the people; recently they have each been remiss and lax, indulging wrongdoing and taking bribes, turning their backs on the public and seeking private gain, so that bandits and robbers arise together and raids and plunder are extreme; reports of treachery repeatedly reach Our ears.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial inspectors are officials who pasture the people; recently they have each been remiss and lax, indulging wrongdoing and taking bribes, turning their backs on the public and seeking private gain, so that bandits and robbers arise together and raids and plunder are extreme; reports of treachery repeatedly reach our ears.

sentences.zh: 朕承太平之運，屬千載之期，思光洪緒，惟新庶績；

translations.literal: We inherit the fortune of peace and belong to the term of a thousand years, thinking to enlarge the great line and renew the myriad achievements;
translations.idiomatic: We inherit the fortune of peace and belong to the term of a thousand years, thinking to enlarge the great line and renew the myriad achievements;

sentences.zh: 亦望蕃翰羣司敷德宣惠，以助沖人，共成斯美。

translations.literal: We also look to the feudal ministers and assembled offices to spread virtue and proclaim grace and together assist Our immaturity in completing this excellence.
translations.idiomatic: We also look to the feudal ministers and assembled offices to spread virtue and proclaim grace and together assist our immaturity in completing this excellence.

sentences.zh: 幸克己復禮，思愆改過，使寡昧無愧於祖宗，百姓見德於當世。

translations.literal: May you restrain yourselves and return to ritual, think on faults and reform errors, so that Our dullness is not shamed before the ancestors and the people see virtue in the present age.
translations.idiomatic: May you restrain yourselves and return to ritual, think on faults and reform errors, so that our dullness is not shamed before the ancestors and the people see virtue in the present age.

sentences.zh: 有司明為條禁，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: The offices are clearly to set forth prohibitions by article, as Our mind intends."
translations.idiomatic: The offices are clearly to set forth prohibitions by article, as our mind intends."

sentences.zh: 」十有二月癸巳，誅南郡王李惠。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: Prince of Nan commandery Li Hui was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, Li Hui, Prince of Nan commandery, was executed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，州鎮二十餘水旱，民飢，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: That year more than twenty provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; the people were hungry and granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than twenty provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; the people were hungry and granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，坤德六合殿成。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day guichou: the Kunde Six Harmonies Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the guichou day, the Kunde Six Harmonies Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔罷行察官。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict abolished touring inspection officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day an edict abolished touring inspection officials.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，帝、太皇太后幸代郡溫泉，問民疾苦，鰥貧者以宮女妻之。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi: the Emperor and Grand Empress Dowager visited the hot springs of Dai commandery, inquired into the people's hardships, and gave palace women as wives to widowers and the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinsi day, the emperor and grand empress dowager visited the hot springs of Dai commandery, inquired into the people's hardships, and gave palace women as wives to widowers and the poor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，乾象六合殿成。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the Qianxiang Six Harmonies Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the Qianxiang Six Harmonies Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: [9]三月甲辰，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: [9] Third month, day jiachen: a partial amnesty in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: [9] In the third month, on the jiachen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，吐谷渾、高麗國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Tuyuhun and Goryeo each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Tuyuhun and Goryeo each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，劉準遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen: Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renshen day, Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，樂良王樂平薨。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Prince of Lele Yueping died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Prince of Lele Yueping died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蠕蠕國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸崞山。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, the court visited Mount Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the court visited Mount Guo.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，淮陽公尉元進爵為王。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Wei Yuan, Duke of Huaiyang, was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Wei Yuan, Duke of Huaiyang, was advanced to prince.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾國遣使獻氂牛五十頭。

translations.literal: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting fifty yak.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting fifty yak.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史、宜都王目辰有罪賜死。

translations.literal: Muchin, inspector of Yong province and Prince of Yidu, was guilty and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Muchin, inspector of Yong province and Prince of Yidu, was guilty and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，帝祈雨於北苑，閉陽門，是日澍雨大洽。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: the Emperor prayed for rain in the northern park and closed Yang Gate; that day timely rain fell abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingsi day, the emperor prayed for rain in the northern park and closed Yang Gate; that day timely rain fell abundantly.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔曰：「昔四代養老，問道乞言。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, an edict said: "In past ages the four dynasties nourished the aged and sought counsel, begging for words.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day an edict said, "In past ages the four dynasties nourished the aged and sought counsel, begging for words.

sentences.zh: 朕雖沖昧，每尚其美。

translations.literal: Though We are immature, We always honor this excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Though we are immature, we always honor this excellence.

sentences.zh: 今賜國老各衣一襲，綿五斤，絹布各五匹。

translations.literal: Now bestow on each national elder one suit of clothing, five jin of cotton, and five bolts each of silk and cloth."
translations.idiomatic: Now bestow on each national elder one suit of clothing, five jin of cotton, and five bolts each of silk and cloth."

sentences.zh: 」六月辛未，以雍州民飢，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei: because the people of Yong province were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day, because the people of Yong province were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 起文石室、靈泉殿於方山。

translations.literal: The Wenshi Chamber and Lingquan Hall were begun on Mount Fang.
translations.idiomatic: The Wenshi Chamber and Lingquan Hall were begun on Mount Fang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳朔，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day jisi new moon: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month of winter, on the jisi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十有一月癸卯，賜京師貧窮、高年、疾患不能自存者衣服布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao: the poor, aged, and sick in the capital who could not support themselves were given clothing and cloth in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guimao day, the poor, aged, and sick in the capital who could not support themselves were given clothing and cloth in differing amounts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，進假梁郡公元嘉爵為假王，督二將出淮陰；

translations.literal: On the guichou day, Acting Prince of Liang commandery Yuan Jia was advanced to acting prince and ordered to command two generals out from Huaiyin;
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Yuan Jia, acting Prince of Liang commandery, was advanced to acting prince and ordered to command two generals out from Huaiyin;

sentences.zh: 隴西公元琛三將出廣陵；

translations.literal: Yuan Chen of Longxi with three generals out from Guangling;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chen of Longxi with three generals out from Guangling;

sentences.zh: 河東公薛虎子三將出壽春。

translations.literal: Xue Huzi of Hedong with three generals out from Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Huzi of Hedong with three generals out from Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕率騎十餘萬南寇，至塞而還。

translations.literal: The Rouran led more than a hundred thousand horse south to raid; they reached the frontier and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran led more than a hundred thousand horse south to raid; they reached the frontier and returned.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，粟特、州逸、河龔、疊伏羅、員闊、悉萬斤諸國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Sogdiana, Zhouyi, Hegong, Diefuluo, Yuan Kuo, Sivanjin, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Sogdiana, Zhouyi, Hegong, Diefuluo, Yuan Kuo, Sivanjin, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是年，島夷蕭道成廢其主劉準而僭立，自號曰齊。

translations.literal: That year the island barbarian Xiao Daocheng deposed his lord Liu Zhun and usurped the throne, styling himself Qi.
translations.idiomatic: That year the island barbarian Xiao Daocheng deposed his lord Liu Zhun and usurped the throne, styling himself Qi.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，[10]幸廷尉、籍坊二獄，引見諸囚。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jimao, [10] the court visited the Ministry of Justice and Registry prisons and summoned the prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the jimao day, [10] the court visited the Ministry of Justice and Registry prisons and summoned the prisoners.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「廷尉者，天下之平，民命之所懸也。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Ministry of Justice is the balance of the realm; the people's lives hang upon it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The Ministry of Justice is the balance of the realm; the people's lives hang upon it.

sentences.zh: 朕得惟刑之恤者，仗獄官之稱其任也。

translations.literal: That We may show pity in punishment depends on the prison officials fitting their charge.
translations.idiomatic: That we may show pity in punishment depends on the prison officials fitting their charge.

sentences.zh: 一夫不耕，將或受其餒；

translations.literal: If one man does not plow, others may suffer his hunger;
translations.idiomatic: If one man does not plow, others may suffer his hunger;

sentences.zh: 一婦不織，將或受其寒。

translations.literal: if one woman does not weave, others may suffer her cold.
translations.idiomatic: if one woman does not weave, others may suffer her cold.

sentences.zh: 今農時要月，百姓肆力之秋，而愚民陷罪者甚眾。

translations.literal: Now it is the crucial month of farming, the autumn when the people exert their strength, yet foolish people who fall into crime are very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Now it is the crucial month of farming, the autumn when the people exert their strength, yet foolish people who fall into crime are very numerous.

sentences.zh: 宜隨輕重決遣，以赴耕耘之業。

translations.literal: Dispose according to lightness and heaviness and send them to farming work."
translations.idiomatic: Dispose according to lightness and heaviness and send them to farming work."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，幸白登山。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the court visited Mount Baideng.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day the court visited Mount Baideng.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜天下貧人一戶之內無雜財穀帛者廩一年。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, households in the realm without miscellaneous property were given one year's grain from the granary.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day households in the realm without miscellaneous property were given one year's grain from the granary.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申朔，幸火山。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen new moon: the court visited Mount Huo.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, on the bingshen day, the court visited Mount Huo.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，還宮。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，以澍雨大洽，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: because timely rain had fallen abundantly, a partial amnesty in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao day, because timely rain had fallen abundantly, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 以紬綾絹布百萬匹及南伐所俘賜王公已下。

translations.literal: A million bolts of silk, damask, thin silk, and cloth and captives from the southern campaign were bestowed on princes and dukes and below.
translations.idiomatic: A million bolts of silk, damask, thin silk, and cloth and captives from the southern campaign were bestowed on princes and dukes and below.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，行幸火山。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinhai: the court traveled to Mount Huo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinhai day, the court traveled to Mount Huo.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改作東明觀。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the Dongming Observatory was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the Dongming Observatory was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 詔會京師耆老，賜錦綵、衣服、几杖、稻米、蜜、麵，復家人不徭役。

translations.literal: An edict assembled the capital's elders and bestowed brocade, clothing, armrests, staffs, rice, honey, and flour; their households were exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assembled the capital's elders and bestowed brocade, clothing, armrests, staffs, rice, honey, and flour; their households were exempted from corvée.

sentences.zh: 悉萬斤國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，幸虎圈，親錄囚徒，輕者皆免之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day dinghai: the court visited the tiger park and personally recorded prisoners; the light cases were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dinghai day, the court visited the tiger park and personally recorded prisoners; the light cases were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，頓丘王李鍾葵有罪賜死。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Li Zhongkui, Prince of Dunqiu, was guilty and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Li Zhongkui, Prince of Dunqiu, was guilty and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 蕭道成角城戍主請舉城內屬。

translations.literal: The garrison commander of Jiaocheng in Xiao Daocheng's realm asked to submit the city inward.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison commander of Jiaocheng in Xiao Daocheng's realm asked to submit the city inward.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔徐州刺史、假梁郡王嘉赴接之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingyou: an edict that Jia, inspector of Xuzhou and Acting Prince of Liang commandery, was to go to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day, an edict ordered Jia, inspector of Xuzhou and acting Prince of Liang commandery, to go to receive them.

sentences.zh: 又遣平南將軍郎大檀三將出朐城，將軍白吐頭二將出海西，將軍元泰二將出連口，將軍封匹三將出角城，[11]鎮南將軍賀羅出下蔡。

translations.literal: Also dispatched General Who Pacifies the South Lang Datan with three generals out from Ju city; General Bai Tutou with two generals out from Haixi; General Yuan Tai with two generals out from Lian mouth; General Feng Pi with three generals out from Jiaocheng; [11] General Who Guards the South Heluo out from Xia cai.
translations.idiomatic: Also dispatched Lang Datan, General Who Pacifies the South, with three generals out from Ju city; Bai Tutou with two generals out from Haixi; Yuan Tai with two generals out from Lian mouth; Feng Pi with three generals out from Jiaocheng; [11] and Heluo, General Who Guards the South, out from Xia cai.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸方山。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, the court visited Mount Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the court visited Mount Fang.

translations.literal: On the wushen day, the court visited the cave temple at Mount Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day the court visited the cave temple at Mount Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，還宮。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸州置冰室。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict that all provinces establish ice houses.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict ordered all provinces to establish ice houses.

sentences.zh: 蕭道成梁州刺史崔慧景遣長史裴叔保率眾寇武興，關城氐帥楊鼠擊破之，叔保還南鄭。

translations.literal: Cui Huijing, governor of Liang province in Xiao Daocheng's realm, sent Chief Clerk Pei Shubao leading troops to raid Wuxing; Yang Shu, Di chief of Guancheng, defeated them and Shubao returned to Nanzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Huijing, governor of Liang province in Xiao Daocheng's realm, sent Chief Clerk Pei Shubao leading troops to raid Wuxing; Yang Shu, Di chief of Guancheng, defeated them and Shubao returned to Nanzheng.

sentences.zh: 九月，蕭道成汝南太守常元真、龍驤將軍胡青苟率戶內屬。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Chang Yuanzhen, administrator of Runan in Xiao Daocheng's realm, and Flying Dragon General Hu Qinggou led their households inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chang Yuanzhen, administrator of Runan in Xiao Daocheng's realm, and Flying Dragon General Hu Qinggou led their households inward.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，思義殿成。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Siyi Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day the Siyi Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，東明觀成。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, the Dongming Observatory was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day the Dongming Observatory was completed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「隆寒雪降，諸在徽纆及轉輸在都或有凍餒，朕用愍焉。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, an edict said: "Severe cold and snow fall; those in fetters and those in transport at the capital may suffer cold and hunger—We are moved for them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day an edict said, "Severe cold and snow fall; those in fetters and those in transport at the capital may suffer cold and hunger—we are moved for them.

sentences.zh: 可遣侍臣詣廷尉獄及有囚之所，周巡省察，飢寒者給以衣食，桎梏者代以輕鎖。

translations.literal: Dispatch attendant ministers to the Ministry of Justice prison and places with prisoners to tour and inspect; give food and clothing to the hungry and cold, and replace heavy shackles with light bonds."
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch attendant ministers to the Ministry of Justice prison and places with prisoners to tour and inspect; give food and clothing to the hungry and cold, and replace heavy shackles with light bonds."

sentences.zh: 」假梁郡王嘉破蕭道成將盧紹之、玄元度於朐山，其下蔡戍主棄城遁走。

translations.literal: Acting Prince of Liang commandery Jia defeated Xiao Daocheng's generals Lu Shaozhi and Xuan Yuandu at Ju Mountain; the garrison chief at Xia cai abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jia, acting Prince of Liang commandery, defeated Xiao Daocheng's generals Lu Shaozhi and Xuan Yuandu at Ju Mountain; the garrison chief at Xia cai abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，詔昌黎王馮熙為西道都督，與征南將軍桓誕出義陽；

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingwei: an edict that Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was western-route commander and, with General Who Campaigns South Huan Dan, advanced from Yiyang;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, an edict made Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, western-route commander and, with Huan Dan, General Who Campaigns South, advanced from Yiyang;

translations.literal: General Who Guards the South Heluo advanced east from Xia cai toward Zhongli.

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jinan Luoba was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao commandery.

sentences.zh: 自今羣官奏事，當獻可替否，無或面從，俾朕之過，彰於遠近。

translations.literal: From now on when the assembled officials present affairs, they should offer what is acceptable and replace what is not—none may agree to Our face, so that Our faults may be made manifest near and far.
translations.idiomatic: From now on when the assembled officials present affairs, they should offer what is acceptable and replace what is not—none may agree to our face, so that our faults may be made manifest near and far.

sentences.zh: 」冀州上言，為粥給飢民，所活七十五萬一千七百餘口。

translations.idiomatic: " Ji province reported that porridge was given to famished people; those kept alive numbered more than 751,700 mouths.

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guichou day, an edict stated, "Pure custom flourished in high antiquity; ritual transformation was employed in recent ages.

sentences.zh: 是以夏殷不嫌一族之婚，周世始絕同姓之娶。

translations.idiomatic: Thus Xia and Yin did not shrink from marriage within one clan; the Zhou age first ended marriage between those of the same surname.

sentences.zh: 斯皆教隨時設，治因事改者也。

translations.literal: These were all teachings set according to the times and government changed with affairs.
translations.idiomatic: These were all teachings set according to the times and government changed with affairs.

sentences.zh: 皇運初基，中原未混，撥亂經綸，日不暇給，古風遺樸，未遑釐改，後遂因循，迄茲莫變。

translations.literal: When the imperial fortune was first founded the central plains were not yet united; in settling disorder and ordering the realm there was no leisure day by day; ancient custom and surviving simplicity were not yet rectified, and later it was followed as precedent until now without change.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial fortune was first founded the central plains were not yet united; in settling disorder and ordering the realm there was no leisure day by day; ancient custom and surviving simplicity were not yet rectified, and later it was followed as precedent until now without change.

sentences.zh: 朕屬百年之期，當後仁之政，思易質舊，式昭惟新。

translations.literal: We stand in the period of a hundred years and ought to enact humane government hereafter; We think to change the substance of the old and make the renewal manifest.
translations.idiomatic: We stand in the period of a hundred years and ought to enact humane government hereafter; we think to change the substance of the old and make the renewal manifest.

sentences.zh: 自今悉禁絕之，有犯以不道論。

translations.literal: From now on let it all be utterly forbidden; violators are to be judged by the statute of impiety.
translations.idiomatic: From now on let it all be utterly forbidden; violators are to be judged by the statute of impiety.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao day, an edict stated, "Establishing offices and ranking salaries has long been practiced.

sentences.zh: 周禮有食祿之典，二漢著受俸之秩。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou have the canon of food-salary; the two Han dynasties set the ranks of receiving stipends.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou have the canon of food-salary; the two Han dynasties set the ranks of receiving stipends.

sentences.zh: 逮于魏晉，莫不聿稽往憲，以經綸治道。

translations.literal: Down to Wei and Jin, none failed to follow former statutes to order the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Wei and Jin, none failed to follow former statutes to order the realm.

sentences.zh: 自中原喪亂，茲制中絕，先朝因循，未遑釐改。

translations.literal: Since the central plains fell into disorder this system was cut off midstream; the former court followed precedent and had no leisure to rectify it.
translations.idiomatic: Since the central plains fell into disorder this system was cut off midstream; the former court followed precedent and had no leisure to rectify it.

sentences.zh: 朕永鑒四方，求民之瘼，夙興昧旦，至於憂勤。

translations.literal: We eternally mirror the four quarters and seek the people's sores, rising early and awaiting dawn unto anxious toil.
translations.idiomatic: We eternally mirror the four quarters and seek the people's sores, rising early and awaiting dawn unto anxious toil.

sentences.zh: 故憲章舊典，始班俸祿。

translations.literal: Therefore We take the old canon as law and first promulgate salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we take the old canon as law and first promulgate salaries.

sentences.zh: 罷諸商人，以簡民事。

translations.literal: Merchant offices are abolished to simplify the people's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Merchant offices are abolished to simplify the people's affairs.

sentences.zh: 戶增調三匹、穀二斛九斗，以為官司之祿。

translations.literal: Each household has an added levy of three bolts and two hu nine dou of grain for official salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Each household has an added levy of three bolts and two hu nine dou of grain for official salaries.

translations.literal: The average advance levy as a two-bolt assessment [17] also serves commercial use.
translations.idiomatic: The average advance levy as a two-bolt assessment [17] also serves commercial use.

sentences.zh: 雖有一時之煩，終克永逸之益。

translations.literal: Though there is temporary trouble for a time, in the end the benefit of lasting ease is achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Though there is temporary trouble for a time, in the end the benefit of lasting ease is achieved.

sentences.zh: 祿行之後，贓滿一匹者死。

translations.literal: After salaries are implemented, corruption reaching one bolt is death.
translations.idiomatic: After salaries are implemented, corruption reaching one bolt is death.

sentences.zh: 變法改度，宜為更始，其大赦天下，與之惟新。

translations.literal: To change law and alter measures ought to be a fresh beginning; a general amnesty throughout the realm shares renewal with it.
translations.idiomatic: To change law and alter measures ought to be a fresh beginning; a general amnesty throughout the realm shares renewal with it.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, an edict stated, "The imperial enterprise is supremely weighty; without broad consultation governance cannot be attained;

sentences.zh: 王務至繁，非博採無以興功。

translations.literal: kingly affairs are supremely numerous; without wide collection achievement cannot be raised.
translations.idiomatic: kingly affairs are supremely numerous; without wide collection achievement cannot be raised.

sentences.zh: 先王知其如此，故虛己以求過，明恕以思咎。

translations.literal: The former kings knew it was thus; therefore they emptied themselves to seek faults and used clear forbearance to reflect on blame.
translations.idiomatic: The former kings knew it was thus; therefore they emptied themselves to seek faults and used clear forbearance to reflect on blame.

sentences.zh: 是以諫鼓置於堯世，謗木立於舜庭，用能耳目四達，庶類咸熙。

translations.literal: Therefore the remonstrance drum was set in the age of Yao and the slander wood stood in Shun's court—thus ears and eyes reached the four quarters and the myriad kinds all flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the remonstrance drum was set in the age of Yao and the slander-wood stood in Shun's court—thus ears and eyes reached the four quarters and the myriad kinds all flourished.

sentences.zh: 朕承累聖之洪基，屬千載之昌運，每布遐風，景行前式。

translations.literal: We inherit the great foundation of successive sages and stand in the flourishing fortune of a thousand years; We constantly spread distant custom and hold up former models as exemplars.
translations.idiomatic: We inherit the great foundation of successive sages and stand in the flourishing fortune of a thousand years; we constantly spread distant custom and hold up former models as exemplars.

sentences.zh: 承明之初，班下內外，聽人各盡規，以補其闕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chenming reign We promulgated it within and without, hearing that each person fully present counsel to repair Our gaps.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Chenming reign we promulgated it within and without, hearing that each person fully present counsel to repair our gaps.

sentences.zh: 中旨雖宣，允稱者少。

translations.literal: Though the central edicts were proclaimed, those truly fitting were few.
translations.idiomatic: Though the central edicts were proclaimed, those truly fitting were few.

sentences.zh: 故變時法，遠遵古典，班制俸祿，改更刑書。

translations.literal: Therefore We changed timely law, far followed ancient canon, promulgated the salary system, and revised the penal code.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we changed timely law, far followed ancient canon, promulgated the salary system, and revised the penal code.

sentences.zh: 寬猛未允，人或異議，思言者莫由申情，求諫者無因自達，故令上明不周，下情壅塞。

translations.literal: Lenience and severity were not yet fitting; people had differing views; those who wished to speak had no way to declare feeling; those who sought remonstrance had no means to reach Us—thus above, clarity was not complete, and below, feeling was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Lenience and severity were not yet fitting; people had differing views; those who wished to speak had no way to declare feeling; those who sought remonstrance had no means to reach us—thus above, clarity was not complete, and below, feeling was blocked.

sentences.zh: 今制百辟卿士，工商吏民，各上便宜。

translations.literal: Now We decree the hundred ministers, grandees, artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners each to submit what is expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Now we decree the hundred ministers, grandees, artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners each to submit what is expedient.

sentences.zh: 利民益治，損化傷政，直言極諫，勿有所隱，務令辭無煩華，理從簡實。

translations.literal: What benefits the people and aids governance, what harms transformation and injures government—speak straight and remonstrate to the limit without hiding anything; strive to make words not florid and tedious and reasoning follow simplicity and substance.
translations.idiomatic: What benefits the people and aids governance, what harms transformation and injures government—speak straight and remonstrate to the limit without hiding anything; strive to make words not florid and tedious and reasoning follow simplicity and substance.

sentences.zh: 朕將親覽，以知世事之要，使言之者無罪，聞之者足以為戒。

translations.literal: We will personally review to know the essentials of worldly affairs, so that those who speak have no crime and those who hear may take warning.
translations.idiomatic: We will personally review to know the essentials of worldly affairs, so that those who speak have no crime and those who hear may take warning.

translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon civil and military officials within and without received salaries in differing amounts.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the ninth year, on the wuyin day, an edict stated, "The rise of prognostic charts began in the three final ages.

sentences.zh: 既非經國之典，徒為妖邪所憑。

translations.literal: They are not canons for ordering the state but only vessels for demonic evil to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: They are not canons for ordering the state but only vessels for demonic evil to rely on.

translations.literal: From now on prognostic charts, esoteric wefts, and texts styled as Confucius's chamber records are all to be burned.

translations.literal: Those who keep them are judged by the great capital statute.
translations.idiomatic: Those who keep them are judged by the great capital statute.

translations.idiomatic: Also all shamans and wizards who falsely claim gods and ghosts and recklessly speak of fortune and misfortune, and alley divinations not recorded in the tomb classics, are strictly forbidden.

translations.idiomatic: We promulgated salaries and pruned punishments, fearing it was not fully fitting; with empty breast we embrace straight remonstrance and think to display great design.

translations.idiomatic: The hundred offices, grandees, and artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners—each submit memorials remonstrating to the limit without hiding anything.
